cashBridge.cashProceedsCNYConversion: 102%face minus explicit USD fee ratio, simplifying FX fixed for receipt; future liability CNYface with USD settlement legal terms
cashBridge.cashScope: cash/876.199mFVwealth/370.127mamortizedfinancialassets aggregate, latter recoverability assumption; exclude restricted/equity/otherreceivable
cashBridge.forecastOperatingConvention: normalized cash after ordinary financing cost from net profit, unlike reported HK OCF before financing bank interest; subtract H1 OCF minus paid bank interest for2026 residual; no repeat forecast bank interest deduction

convertible.bear: 2027 cash repay full2.18bn; no underlying dilution; newbank funding needed in simplified bridge
convertible.baseBull: 2027 fullyconvert, underlying shares added, no cash debt repayment and no double debt deduction
convertible.priceConvention: YE and half use 2027 earnings on postconversion diluted shares prospectively, actual liability remains before conversion; price suffices at modeled base/bull PE but outcome not assured
convertible.limitations: full legal fixed/prevailing FX and conversion price adjustment path not modelled; shortmaturity and policy event redemption preserve downside risk

assumptions.forecast: segment future sales/margins/expenses/sharecount all research judgments not management guidance; annual EBIT bridge contains D&A in gross/admin; FXloss normalized not wholly eliminated inbase
assumptions.equity: net parent PE capitalizes recurring earnings after debt costs; cash not added and netdebt not separately deducted; FV/equity investment gain and nonsustainable grant/income excluded
assumptions.cash: 2026 residualsubtract actualH1 OCF/capex, includes SeptCBnet once; bank funding and forecast cash explicit, not cashrunway assurance; leaseprincipal additional cash after IFRS netincome+DA bridge
assumptions.dividend: 2025finalCNY.20/HKD.2299274,exdate2026July7,recordJuly15,payAug7,previousentitlement excluded; futureannual assumed payablefollowingyearAugust withmodelFX1.10 nonactual; YEhalf0; 2026cash actual364.962m excludes trust dividend
assumptions.shares: legal1837283628 less treasury1866830; separate IFRS award trusts and incentives. normalforecast adds futureawards; CB70.478579m additional inbasebull2027+, no cash repay
assumptions.CB: 2.18bnCNYface,USDsettlement,102%issue,zero coupon,2027Aug31maturity,36.08HKDconversion; financing is cash and liability not gift, PE bridge avoids double debt
assumptions.weights: 25/50/25 judgment not probabilities or confidence interval
